verdict.rationale: Moss documents API key lifecycle management: creating, listing and deleting keys via the CLI, plus rotation with overlap. It also describes a separate pattern for browser and untrusted clients so the projectKey is never embedded, which hints at a narrower credential path. However, no evidence shows keys can be scoped to specific indexes, actions or read-only access. Missing for 10: explicit per-key scopes/permissions (e.g., read-only or per-index), documented short-lived agent tokens, independent corroboration.
